'''Paul Clavin''' is a [[French people|French]] scientist at [[Aix-Marseille University]], working in the field of [[combustion]] and [[statistical mechanics]]. He is the founder of Institute for Research on Nonequilibrium Phenomena (IRPHE).<ref>{{Cite journal | doi=10.1063/PT.3.3665| title=Combustion Waves and Fronts in Flows: Flames, Shocks, Detonations, Ablation Fronts and Explosion of Stars ''Combustion'' Waves and Fronts in Flows: Flames, Shocks, Detonations, Ablation Fronts and Explosion of Stars, Paul Clavin and Geoff Searby, Cambridge U. Press, 2016, 720 p, $190.00, ISBN 978-1-107-09868-8| journal=Physics Today| volume=70| issue=8| pages=62| year=2017| last1=Poinsot| first1=Thierry| bibcode=2017PhT....70h..62P| doi-access=free}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Paul Clavin obtained his first degree at [[ENSMA]] and then a Master's degree in Mathematics and Plasma Physics. For his PhD, he joined [[Ilya Prigogine]] in [[Brussels]] from 1967 to 1970<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Cugliandolo |first1=Leticia F. |title=Out-of-equilibrium dynamics of classical and quantum complex systems |journal=Comptes Rendus. Physique |date=October 2013 |volume=14 |issue=8 |pages=685–699 |doi=10.1016/j.crhy.2013.09.004 |arxiv=1305.7126 |bibcode=2013CRPhy..14..685C }}</ref> and then returned to [[Poitiers]]. Paul Clavin moved to [[Aix-Marseille University]] in the late 1970s and created the combustion research group.

Clavin served as the chair of the Physical Mechanics at [[Institut Universitaire de France]] from 1993 to 2004 and the administrator from 2000 to 2005.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://cefrc.princeton.edu/combustion-summer-school/archived-programs/2015-session-2/lecturers-1#comp0000567fb6b50000000181361f|title=Lecturers - Combustion Energy Frontier Research Center|website=cefrc.princeton.edu}}</ref> He received Ya.B. Zeldovich Gold Medal from [[The Combustion Institute]] in 2014<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.combustioninstitute.org/resources/awards/ya-b-zeldovich-gold-medal/|title=Ya. B. Zeldovich Gold Medal - The Combustion Institute|newspaper=The Combustion Institute &#124; Promoting and Disseminating Combustion Science Research|date=24 June 2016|archive-date=8 June 2023|access-date=4 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230608052440/https://www.combustioninstitute.org/resources/awards/ya-b-zeldovich-gold-medal/|url-status=dead}}</ref> and a fellow of [[The Combustion Institute]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.combustioninstitute.org/resources/awards/fellows-of-the-combustion-institute/|title=Fellows of The Combustion Institute - The Combustion Institute|newspaper=The Combustion Institute &#124; Promoting and Disseminating Combustion Science Research|date=20 June 2017|archive-date=8 June 2023|access-date=4 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230608051502/https://www.combustioninstitute.org/resources/awards/fellows-of-the-combustion-institute/|url-status=dead}}</ref> A workshop titled ''Out-of-Equilibrium Dynamics'' was conducted in 2012 in honor of Clavin's 70th birthday.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.irphe.fr/~ooed/index.html|title=Out-Of-Equilibrium Dynamics|website=www.irphe.fr}}</ref> He is the recipient of Grand Prix award from [[French Academy of Sciences]] in 1998 and received Plumey award from [[Société Française de Physique]] in 1988. He was elected membre correspondent at the [[French Academy of Sciences|French Academy of sciences]] in 1997.<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-C/paul-clavin.html|publication-date=}}</ref>
